$comment: Each desktop's ecosystem, for "Install the entire ecosystem": what its NixOS module already installs (`essentials`, shown on the Desktop layer) and the rest of its family of apps (`apps`, preselected in the app store) and command-line tools (`cli`, preselected in the shell layer). `category` is the store (or shell) category, used where AppStream has none. Researched 2026-09-26 from the NixOS 26.05 modules, upstream app lists (apps.gnome.org and GNOME Circle, apps.kde.org, elementary, Linux Mint, LXQt, COSMIC) and each window manager's docs and default config; `nix build .#catalog` fails if an attribute leaves nixpkgs. Omarchy's ecosystem is its flake's own (omarchy.ecosystem.enable). `exclude` is the NixOS option that removes an essential (the installer shows the removable ones selected, `apps.without` lists the ones taken out), `core` the essentials it can't remove (checks.essentials keeps both true).

ecosystems.description: GNOME Circle, GNOME's development tools and games, and the rest of GNOME's and GNOME World's apps
KDE's application family: KDE Gear (PIM, games, education, multimedia, graphics, utilities, SDK) and KDE's independently released apps such as Krita, digiKam, Kdenlive, KStars and LabPlot
System76's COSMIC apps not installed by default plus third-party libcosmic apps (cosmic-utils and COSMIC Store apps)
Hyprland with the hypr* ecosystem (hyprlock, hypridle, hyprpaper, hyprlauncher, hyprpolkitagent, ...) plus Waybar, mako and the wiki's must-haves
niri as its wiki and default config set it up: Waybar, fuzzel, Alacritty, mako, swaylock, swaybg, swayidle, xwayland-satellite, Nautilus and a polkit agent
Xfce's own applications (the Xfce 'apps' family) not installed by default
Linux Mint's own apps and the rest of the apps Linux Mint ships with Cinnamon
LXQt's own Qt applications plus the lightweight Qt apps the LXQt project recommends alongside it
MATE Tweak and the apps Ubuntu MATE ships alongside the MATE desktop
The companion apps Budgie distributions (Ubuntu Budgie) ship alongside Budgie's MATE and Nemo defaults
elementary OS's remaining apps and the curated AppCenter apps built for elementary OS
Lomiri/Ubuntu Touch's core apps (all installed by default on NixOS) and the Ubuntu Touch app developer tools
Sway's own tools (swaylock, swayidle, swaybar, wmenu, foot) plus Waybar, mako, grimshot and the sway wiki's common add-ons
labwc with its own companions (labwc-tweaks, menu generator, GTK theme) and the tools from its integration docs and example autostart: Waybar, mako, swaybg, swaylock, swayidle, kanshi
river (classic) with the river wiki's usual picks: Waybar, fuzzel, mako, swaybg, swayidle, kanshi, grim and slurp
Wayfire with wf-shell and WCM plus the tools its default wayfire.ini calls: Alacritty, wofi, swaylock, wlogout, mako, kanshi, wlsunset, grim
mangowc with the dependencies of its author's reference config: Waybar, rofi, foot, swaync, swaybg, swaylock-effects, wlogout, satty, SwayOSD
i3 as its default config sets it up (i3status, dmenu, i3lock via xss-lock, nm-applet) plus dunst, rofi, picom, feh and maim
Openbox with ObConf and the classic Openbox desktop around it: tint2 panel, XDG menu, nitrogen, dunst, picom
IceWM (taskbar, menu, tray and wallpaper built in) plus tray applets, a notifier, a screensaver/locker and a file manager
Fluxbox (toolbar, slit and menu built in) plus feh for fbsetbg, tray applets, dunst and a locker
awesome (bar, menu, notifications and wallpaper built in) plus a compositor, a locker, tray applets and a file manager
bspwm with sxhkd and its example config's urxvt and dmenu, plus the usual polybar, picom, feh and dunst
xmonad with its default dmenu and gmrun bindings and the tutorial's xmobar, trayer, xscreensaver and scrot
herbstluftwm with what its default autostart and panel.sh use (xterm, dmenu, dzen2) plus feh, dunst and a locker
FVWM3 (pager, buttons and menus built in) plus a notifier, a locker, tray volume and network applets and a file manager
JWM (tray, menu and pager built in) with the JWM Settings Manager plus tray applets, dunst and a locker
Window Maker (WPrefs, dock and clip built in) with the classic dockapps (system tray, clock, monitor, mixer)
spectrwm with what its default config calls (dmenu, xlock, scrot via screenshot.sh) plus feh, dunst and picom
LeftWM with its default bindings (Alacritty, dmenu, slock), the theme manager and the common theme dependencies (polybar, picom, feh)
pekwm (panel, menus and wallpaper built in) plus a notifier, a locker, a file manager and a screenshot tool
ratpoison, keyboard-only and minimal: a notifier, slock and command-line helpers
StumpWM (mode line and launcher built in) with a notifier, slock and command-line helpers
cwm with its default xterm and xlock bindings plus feh, dunst and command-line helpers
evilwm, minimalist: feh for the wallpaper, a notifier, slock and command-line helpers
AfterStep (Wharf, pager and backgrounds built in) plus a notifier, a locker and a file manager
Enlightenment 16 (pager, iconbox, menus and backgrounds built in) plus a notifier, a locker and a file manager
Sawfish (with sawfish-config) plus a tint2 panel, tray applets, a notifier, a locker and a file manager
Notion (status bar and menus built in) plus a notifier, a locker and command-line helpers
dwm the suckless way: dmenu, st, slstatus and slock, plus dunst and feh
